text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたが知恵の真髄にたどりついたら
彼女と理解しあえるかもしれません。
text.official_en: Once you finally begin to make your own intellectual breakthroughs, perhaps you and Shantotto can begin to relate.
text.real_en: Once you reach the very essence of wisdom, perhaps you and she will understand each other.

text.jp:
あなたとシャントットは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and she are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Shantotto are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとシャントットは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and she have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Shantotto are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield her power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
けれど彼女は国を代表する立場で、時には
他国との交渉にあたる責任を担います。
text.official_en: While that may be true to an extent, as a representative of her country, she must occasionally negotiate with other political entities.
text.real_en: But she represents her country, and at times she bears responsibility for negotiations with other nations.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
さまざまな種族が壮大な歴史を刻む世界、
ヴァナ・ディール。
text.official_en: Various and sundry peoples—of all shapes, sizes, and creeds—called this world home.
text.real_en: Vana’diel, a world where many different peoples have shaped an epic history.

text.jp: それでも人として生活する
text.official_en: Live a normal life.

text.jp: それは、悠遠なる歴史が息づく異界の記憶――
text.official_en: That world’s name is Vana’diel, and its history is long and storied.
text.real_en: A memory of another world steeped in ancient history...

text.jp:
たぐいまれなる知識と魔力で
世界の支配者になれるとしたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to be blessed with extensive knowledge and powerful magic—so much so that you could rule the whole world—what would you do?

text.jp:
ただあなたの行動によっては、彼女は
興味を失って、去ってしまうはずです。
text.official_en: Depending on how you choose to wield that power, however, she may instead <text style="italic">lose</> all interest in you.
text.real_en: But depending on what you do, she would surely lose interest and walk away.

text.jp:
とてつもない魔力を誇るシャントットの
生き方は、自由そのものに見えます。
text.official_en: As she possesses potent magic, Shantotto may seem to lead a life that is freedom manifest.

text.jp:
どれほど力があっても、たゆまず知識を
追求する姿勢は、彼女に似ています。
text.official_en: To continue on your quest for knowledge, in spite of possessing veritable omnipotence, is something Shantotto would laud.
text.real_en: The drive to keep seeking knowledge, no matter how powerful you become, is something you share with her.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
ふだん冒険者たちを虐げている彼女も
まだまだ人生から学ぶことでしょう。
text.official_en: Though Shantotto often shows disdain for adventurers, perhaps she could learn from them—and from you.
text.real_en: Even Shantotto, who usually makes life hard for adventurers, surely still has much to learn from life.

text.jp: まず開けてから考える
text.official_en: Open it first and figure out the rest later.

text.jp:
もし彼女が望むなら、その魔力で
神の座に近づけるかもしれません。
text.official_en: Add her potent magic to the fold, and it would be no stretch of the imagination to say she could attain divinity.
text.real_en: If she wished it, her magic might even bring her close to the realm of the gods.

text.jp:
シャントットの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: Her thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Shantotto’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
世界を救うという、あなたの存在に
彼女は知的な興味を示すでしょう。
text.official_en: Insomuch as you have the power to save the world, Shantotto may very well take an intellectual interest in you.

text.jp: 冷静に情勢を解きほぐす
text.official_en: Stay calm and alleviate tensions.

text.jp:
危うきに近づかないのは賢明ですが
シャントットの判断は異なるでしょう。
text.official_en: While keeping oneself out of harm’s way is certainly prudent, it is not the course of action Shantotto would take.

text.jp: 危ないから誰かに頼む
text.official_en: Let someone else subject themselves to danger.
text.real_en: Ask someone else to do it because it is dangerous.

text.jp:
危険を引き受けて、実力で乗り切れば、
彼女はあなたを気に入るかもしれません。
text.official_en: Should this tactic succeed, thus proving your skills commensurate with your bravado, she may even take a liking to you.
text.real_en: If you can take on the danger and overcome it through your own skill, she might take a liking to you.

text.jp:
国と国の思惑がすれちがい
戦争の危機が迫ったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Should another nation fail to see eye to eye with your own, thus setting them both on a path toward war, what would you do?

text.jp:
圧倒的な実力を示して、戦いを防ぐ。
彼女のように、強くなれるでしょうか。
text.official_en: With such an ostentatious—not to mention commanding—approach, you, too, could perhaps soar to Shantotto’s heights.
text.real_en: You would prevent a fight by showing overwhelming strength. Could you become as strong as she is?

text.jp: 引き下がって争いを避ける
text.official_en: Acquiesce to avoid conflict.

text.jp:
彼女のように強くなれたら
危険すらも楽しめるでしょう。
text.official_en: Should your powers ever match Shantotto’s, you may come to relish danger rather than fear it.
text.real_en: If you could become as powerful as she is, you might even learn to enjoy danger.

text.jp:
彼女の名は、シャントット……。
あなたの想いが、彼女との絆になる。
text.official_en: That black mage’s name was Shantotto, and it is with her you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: Her name was Shantotto... Your feelings will form a bond with her.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp:
戦争は避けるべきですが、彼女の判断は
しばしば常識の枠を踏み越えます。
text.official_en: While preventing a war is of the utmost import, Shantotto would much rather crush common sense underfoot than be bound by it.

text.jp:
扉の前で悩むより、扉を開けて判断。
大胆ですが合理的ですね。
text.official_en: Only so much can be gleaned from one side of a door, so you open it to see the other. Bold, but certainly not foolish.
text.real_en: Rather than worry about what is behind the door, you open it and judge for yourself. Bold, but rational.

text.jp: 支配よりも知恵を求める
text.official_en: Pursue knowledge rather than power.

text.jp:
果てなき歴史を紡ぐ異界の幻影　シャントット
ひたむきに知を求める、孤高の学究。
text.official_en:
Maven of Magic Shantotto
The solitary scholar and avid pursuer of knowledge.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision from a history without end: Shantotto. A solitary scholar, tirelessly seeking knowledge.

text.jp: 格の違いを見せつける
text.official_en: Upstage the representative then and there.
text.real_en: Show them how far out of their league they are.

text.jp:
比類なき魔力と知識を誇る黒魔道士として
畏れられる淑女がいました。
text.official_en: Among these individuals was a black mage—one who was feared for her unprecedented knowledge and tremendous powers.
text.real_en: There was a lady feared as a black mage of unmatched magical power and knowledge.

text.jp:
生涯をかけて学ぶ彼女の知識は、
人の理解を超える高みにあります。
text.official_en: The depth and breadth of Shantotto’s knowledge is not only impressive, it nigh defies human understanding.

text.jp:
相手が力で脅すなら、はるかに上回る力を
見せつけ、黙らせてしまうのですね。
text.official_en: Should your opponent threaten you with force, showing them the extent of yours should quickly put them in their place.

text.jp:
知識への好奇心、刺激への冒険心を
抑えられないのですね。
text.official_en: Intriguing. You can neither quench your thirst for knowledge, nor sate your appetite for adventure.

text.jp:
秘められた知識を追うだけでなく
生活から学ぶことも大事ですね。
text.official_en: Knowledge is not to be found only in tomes and scrolls, but to be accrued through experience as well.
text.real_en: There is much to learn from everyday life, not only from the pursuit of hidden knowledge.

text.jp:
脅されても冷静に観察し、真実をつかめば
理解しあえることもあります。
text.official_en: Be not cowed by threats, but ascertain the truth by remaining calm and objective, and you may yet find common ground.

text.jp:
脅しをはねのけるのは、自分を信じる心の強さ。
だから彼女は常に落ち着いているのです。
text.official_en: Shantotto is rarely ever cowed, and for good reason: confidence keeps fear at bay, and she has confidence in spades.
text.real_en: Her confidence in herself gives her the strength to reject threats. That is why she remains so calm.

text.jp: 自分の手で世界を救う
text.official_en: Save the world singlehandedly.

text.jp:
行く手の危険を避けるのではなく
踏み越えて進むはずです。
text.official_en: For Shantotto, danger is not something to be avoided, but rather something to be conquered.

text.jp:
誇り高い彼女なら、挑発されて
引き下がることはなさそうです。
text.official_en: Taking this into consideration, she would more likely go on the offensive than the defensive.
text.real_en: Proud as she is, Shantotto would hardly back down in the face of provocation.

text.jp:
開けば破滅を招く扉の奥に
秘められた知識が眠っているとしたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to stand before a door—behind which lay vast stores of knowledge, but if opened would usher in untold amounts of destruction—what would you do?

text.jp: 面白そうだから開ける
text.official_en: Give in to curiosity and open it.
